options.text: Have you any quests for me?

steps.player: Have you any quests for me?

steps.speaker: Duke Horacio
steps.text: Well, I wouldn't describe it as a quest, but there is something I could use some help with.

steps.speaker: Duke Horacio
steps.text: We were recently sorting through some of the things stored down in the cellar, and we found this old talisman.
The Duke shows you a talisman.

steps.speaker: Duke Horacio
steps.text: The Order of Wizards over at the Wizards' Tower have been on the hunt for magical artefacts recently. I wonder if this might be just the kind of thing they're after.

steps.speaker: Duke Horacio
steps.text: Would you be willing to take it to them for me?

steps.speaker: Duke Horacio
steps.text: Thank you very much. You'll find the Wizards' Tower south west of here, across the bridge from Draynor Village. When you arrive, look for Sedridor. He is the Archmage of the wizards there.
The Duke hands you the talisman.

steps.speaker: Duke Horacio
steps.text: As you wish. Hopefully I can find someone else to help.

options.text: What did you want me to do again?

steps.player: What did you want me to do again?

steps.text: If the player lost the talisman:

steps.player: What did you want me to do again?

steps.speaker: Duke Horacio
steps.text: Did you take that talisman to Sedridor?

steps.speaker: Duke Horacio
steps.text: Ah, well that explains things. One of my servants found it outside, and it seemed too much of a coincidence that another would suddenly show up.

steps.speaker: Duke Horacio
steps.text: Here, take it to the Wizards' Tower, south west of here. Please try not to lose it this time.
The Duke hands you the talisman.
If the player has the talisman:

steps.speaker: Duke Horacio
steps.text: Take that talisman I gave you to Sedridor at the Wizards' Tower. You'll find it south west of here, across the bridge from Draynor Village.

delivering-the-talisman-talking-to-archm.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
delivering-the-talisman-talking-to-archm.text: Welcome adventurer, to the world renowned Wizards' Tower, home to the Order of Wizards. We are the oldest and most prestigious group of wizards around. Now, how may I help you?

delivering-the-talisman-talking-to-archm.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
delivering-the-talisman-talking-to-archm.text: Sedridor? What is it you want with him?

delivering-the-talisman-talking-to-archm.player: The Duke of Lumbridge sent me to find him. I have this talisman he found. He said Sedridor would be interested in it.

delivering-the-talisman-talking-to-archm.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
delivering-the-talisman-talking-to-archm.text: Did he now? Well hand it over then, and we'll see what all the hubbub is about.

steps.text: If the player has the talisman:
You hand the talisman to Sedridor.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Hmm... Doesn't seem to be anything too special. Just a normal air talisman by the looks of things. Still, looks can be deceiving. Let me take a closer look...
Sedridor murmurs some sort of incantation and the talisman glows slightly.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: How interesting... It would appear I spoke too soon. There's more to this talisman than meets the eye. In fact, it may well be the last piece of the puzzle.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Indeed! The lost legacy of the first tower. This talisman may in fact be key to finding the forgotten essence mine!

steps.player: First tower? Forgotten essence mine? What are you on about?

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Ah, my apologies, adventurer. Allow me to fill you in.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: As you are likely aware, when we cast spells, we do so using the power of runes.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: These runes are crafted from a highly unique material, and then imbued with magical power from various runic altars. Different altars create different runes with different magical effects.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: The process of imbuing runes is called runecrafting. Legend has it that this was once a common art, but the secrets of how to do it were lost until just under two hundred years ago.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: The rediscovery of runecrafting had such a large impact on the world, that it marked the dawn of the Fifth Age. It also resulted in the birth of our order, and the construction of the first Wizards' Tower.

steps.player: If it was the first tower, I'm guessing it doesn't exist anymore? What happened?

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: It was burnt down by traitorous members of our own order. They followed the evil god of chaos, Zamorak, and they wished to claim our magical discoveries in his name.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: When the tower burnt down, much was lost, including an important incantation. A spell that could be used to teleport to a hidden essence mine.

steps.player: The essence mine you mentioned earlier, I assume?

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Precisely. Rune essence is the material used to make runes, but it is incredibly rare. That essence mine was the only place it could be found that our order knew of.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Since the incantation was lost, we have struggled to maintain our stocks of rune essence.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: There are seemingly those out there that still know where to find some, but while they have been willing to sell essence to us, they have refused to share knowledge on how to find it ourselves.

steps.player: I'm starting to see why this is so important. So you think this talisman can help you rediscover that incantation?

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: I do! All magic leaves traces, and from what I can tell, this talisman was used heavily during the time of the first tower.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: It would have been taken to the essence mine many times, and the magical energies there will have left an imprint on it. To think that it was hidden in Lumbridge all this time!

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: It is critical I share this discovery with my associate, Aubury, as soon as possible. He's not much of a wizard, but he's an expert on runecrafting, and his insight will be essential.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Would you be willing to visit him for me? I would go myself, but I wish to study this talisman some more.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: He runs a rune shop in the south east of Varrock. Please, take this package of research notes to him. If all goes well, the secrets of the essence mine may soon be ours once more!
Sedridor hands you a package.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Best of luck, [player name].
If the player gave the talisman to him while doubting his identity:
If the player gave the talisman to him without doubting his identity:

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: As you wish adventurer. I will continue to study this talisman you have brought me. Return here if you find yourself with some spare time to help me.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Oh... Well I guess the short of it is that this talisman could be key to helping us rediscover an important teleportation incantation.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: With it, we'll be able to access a hidden essence mine, our lost source of rune essence.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: It is critical I share this discovery with my associate, Aubury, as soon as possible. He's not much of a wizard, but he's an expert on runecrafting, and his insight will be essential.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Would you be willing to visit him for me? I would go myself, but I wish to study this talisman some more.
If the player does not have the talisman:

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Well?

steps.player: I don't seem to have it with me.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Hmm? You are a very odd person. Come back again when you have it.

options.text: No, I'll only give it to Sedridor.

steps.player: No, I'll only give it to Sedridor.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Well good news, for I am Sedridor! Now, hand it over and let me have a proper look at it, hmm?

options.text: No, I don't think you are Sedridor.

steps.player: No, I don't think you are Sedridor.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Hmm... Well, I admire your caution adventurer. Perhaps I can prove myself? I will use my mental powers to discover...

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Your name is... [player name]!

steps.player: You're right! How did you know that?

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Well I am the Archmage you know! You don't get to my position without learning a few tricks along the way!

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: So now that I have proved myself to you, why don't you hand over that talisman, hmm?

delivering-the-talisman-talking-to-archm.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
delivering-the-talisman-talking-to-archm.text: Welcome back, adventurer. Do you have that talisman now?
If the player doesn't have the talisman:

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Well come back when you have it.

delivering-the-talisman-talking-to-archm.text: If the player does have the talisman:

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Welcome back, adventurer. Do you have that talisman now?
You hand the talisman to Sedridor.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Hmm... Doesn't seem to be anything too special. Just a normal air talisman by the looks of things. Still, looks can be deceiving. Let me take a closer look...
Sedridor murmurs some sort of incantation and the talisman glows slightly.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: How interesting... It would appear I spoke too soon. There's more to this talisman than meets the eye. In fact, it may well be the last piece of the puzzle.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Indeed! The lost legacy of the first tower. This talisman may in fact be key to finding the forgotten essence mine!

steps.player: First tower? Forgotten essence mine? What are you on about?

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Ah, my apologies, adventurer. Allow me to fill you in.

delivering-the-talisman-talking-to-archm.player: So is that talisman of any use to you?

delivering-the-talisman-talking-to-archm.text: Continues previous dialogue starting at "You hand the talisman to Sedridor"

delivering-the-talisman-talking-to-archm.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
delivering-the-talisman-talking-to-archm.text: Hello again, adventurer. Please, take this package of research notes to Aubury in Varrock. He runs a rune shop in the south east of the city.
If the player gave the talisman to while doubting his identity:
If the player gave the talisman to him without doubting his identity:

steps.player: I don't remember telling you my name... How do you know it?

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Really now? I am the Archmage you know.

delivering-the-talisman-talking-to-archm.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
delivering-the-talisman-talking-to-archm.text: Hello again, adventurer. Did you take that package to Aubury?
If the player lost the package:

steps.player: I lost it. Could I have another?

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Well it's a good job I have copies of everything.
Sedridor hands you a package.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Best of luck, [player name].
If the player gave the talisman to while doubting his identity:
If the player gave the talisman to him without doubting his identity:

delivering-the-talisman-talking-to-archm.text: If the player has the package:

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: He runs a rune shop in the south east of Varrock. Please deliver it to him soon.

delivering-the-research-package-talking-.speaker: Aubury
delivering-the-research-package-talking-.text: Do you want to buy some runes?

options.text: I've been sent here with a package for you.

steps.player: I've been sent here with a package for you.

steps.speaker: Aubury
steps.text: A package? From who?

steps.player: From Sedridor at the Wizards' Tower.

steps.speaker: Aubury
steps.text: From Sedridor? But... surely, he can't have? Please, let me have it. It must be extremely important for him to have sent a stranger.
If the player has the package:
You hand the package to Aubury.

steps.speaker: Aubury
steps.text: Now, let's have a look...
Aubury goes through the package of research notes.

steps.speaker: Aubury
steps.text: This... this is incredible.

steps.speaker: Aubury
steps.text: My gratitude to you adventurer for bringing me these research notes. Thanks to you, I think we finally have it.

steps.speaker: Aubury
steps.text: Well when we combine my own research with this latest discovery, I think we might just...

steps.speaker: Aubury
steps.text: No, no, I'm getting ahead of myself. The signs are promising, but let's not jump to any conclusions just yet.

steps.speaker: Aubury
steps.text: Here, take these notes back to Sedridor. They should hopefully give him everything he needs.
Aubury hands you some research notes.

steps.speaker: Aubury
steps.text: Before you leave, why not have a cup of tea?

options.text: I'd love a cup of tea.

steps.player: I'd love a cup of tea.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cuppa tea!

steps.text: If the player does not have the package:

steps.player: Uh... yeah... about that... I kind of don't have it with me...

steps.speaker: Aubury
steps.text: What kind of person says they have a delivery for me, but not with them? Honestly.

steps.speaker: Aubury
steps.text: Come back when you have it.

options.text: Oh, it's a rune shop. No thank you, then.

delivering-the-research-package-talking-.speaker: Aubury
delivering-the-research-package-talking-.text: Do you want to buy some runes?

options.text: Anything useful in that package I gave you?

steps.player: Anything useful in that package I gave you?

steps.speaker: Aubury
steps.text: Well, let's have a look...
Continues previous dialogue starting at "Aubury goes through the package of research notes."

delivering-the-research-package-talking-.speaker: Aubury
delivering-the-research-package-talking-.text: Here, take these notes back to Sedridor. They should hopefully give him everything he needs.
Continues previous dialogue starting at "Aubury hands you some research notes."

delivering-the-research-package-talking-.speaker: Aubury
delivering-the-research-package-talking-.text: Hello. Did you take those notes back to Sedridor?
If the player lost the notes:

steps.speaker: Aubury
steps.text: Well, luckily I have duplicates. It's a good thing they are written in code. I wouldn't want the wrong kind of person to get access to the information contained within.
Aubury hands you some research notes.

delivering-the-research-package-talking-.text: If the player has the notes:

steps.speaker: Aubury
steps.text: Don't take too long. He'll be eager to see if this is indeed the breakthrough we were hoping for.

steps.speaker: Aubury
steps.text: Now, did you want to buy some runes?

delivering-the-research-notes-talking-to.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
delivering-the-research-notes-talking-to.text: Ah, [player name]. How goes your quest? Have you delivered my research to Aubury yet?

delivering-the-research-notes-talking-to.player: Yes, I have. He gave me some notes to give to you.

delivering-the-research-notes-talking-to.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
delivering-the-research-notes-talking-to.text: Wonderful! Let's have a look then.
If the player has the notes:

steps.text: You hand the notes to Sedridor.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Alright, let's see what Aubury has for us...

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Yes, this is it! The lost incantation!

steps.player: So you'll be able to access that essence mine now?

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: That's right! Because of you, our order finally has a proper source of rune essence again! Thank you, friend.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: If you ever want to access the essence mine yourself, just let me know. It's the least I can do.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: I will also share the incantation with others, including Aubury. When I do, I'll let them know that you are to be given unlimited access to the mine.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Oh, and you can have this air talisman back as well. I have no further need of it, and I'm sure you will find it useful.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: In case you didn't know, the talisman can be used to craft air runes. Just take it to the Air Altar south of Falador along with some rune essence.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Don't worry if you can't find the altar. The talisman can guide you there. You may find talismans for other altars as well while adventuring. They'll let you craft other types of rune.

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: My pleasure!
Congratulations! Quest complete!

options.text: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine?
Who else knows the teleport to the Rune Essence Mine?
Could you tell me about the old Wizards' Tower?

delivering-the-research-notes-talking-to.text: If the player does not have the notes:

steps.player: Err, you're not going to believe this...

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: What?

steps.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
steps.text: Right... You're rather careless aren't you. I suggest you go and speak to Aubury once more. With luck he will have made copies.

Qh_npu.player: I don't remember telling you my name... How do you know it?

Qh_npu.speaker: Archmage Sedridor
Qh_npu.text: Really now? I am the Archmage you know.
